name: 蓑虫ひむか🚬👶🍺アラサー女児Vtuber
description: 酒とタバコと麻雀大好きVtuberバーチャルアラサー女児の蓑虫ひむかです！ セルフ受肉とゆうやつ。雀魂/ホラゲ/お絵描き/飲酒雑談とかとかやるよ……赤木しげる限界オタクとFF7やっかいオタクもしてる。ご依頼はこちら→ https://skeb.jp/@Vhimcaminomushi

works.body:
蓑虫ひむかさん　
いつもお世話になっております、個人Vtuberのシアカマコトと申します。

今回依頼させて頂きたいのが、私が不定期で活動してる「シアカマコ」のクリスマス衣装で描いていただけないでしょか？
「あなたのお隣に住んでいる隣人のおねいさん」という設定です。
・ポーズ、表情ともに指定はございませんのでおまかせ致します。
※左半身の影っぽいのは火傷跡です
※多少セクシーよりな衣装でも大丈夫です

もし宜しければイラストは活動上(Twitter、Youtube、Twitchなど)で使用させていただきたく、
人物とその他をレイヤー分けされた状態の物か、単体のデータを頂けますと嬉しいです。
以上、ご検討頂けますと幸いです。
注文が多くて申し訳ありません

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qFhDYoi21ucFHABiJoSKkNN4dMZ1Us8m?usp=sharing

お世話になっております。Vtuberの逸見庵仁と申します。
以前描いていただいたイラストがとても素晴らしかったので、今回も私・逸見庵仁を描いていただきたいと思いリクエストさせていただきました。

モデルですがゲーム/アニメ作品「アークナイツ」の主人公が着ている服装を逸見庵仁に着せていただく事は可能でしょうか？
マスクをしていますが顔がわかるように外していただければと思います。

上記以外はおまかせにてお願いしたく、自由に描いていただけますと幸いです。

使用用途：
描いていただきましたイラストは、Youtubeの配信用のサムネイルや各種SNSで使用させていただけますと有り難いです。

形式：
サムネイルなどでも使わせていただきたいため、可能であれば背景とキャラは分けたデータ（背景透過）も納品頂けると助かります。

Good evening!
I have always thought that you are a very nice painter.
I am happy to be able to commission you in this way.

As for your request
I, Pagu the Third (either 2D or 3D), would like you to draw me.
There are no specifications regarding composition, clothing, etc.
I would be happy to have you draw me in any way you like.

If you would like to give us a description of your character as a reference, we would like to know
He is a mild-mannered, drunken, random guy who likes bio and DBD.
Thank you for your consideration.
https://twitter.com/1221pagu/status/1586854142026604547?s=46&t=eaRn0TlPOcSujpDzGwSsYQ

This is my first Skeb request!

I would like to have a portrait of myself, Chiyoko Mutsuki, in a suit, and I will leave the composition, etc. to you.
If possible, I would like to use it as an icon or a thumbnail for distribution, so I would appreciate it if you could give me a transparent version as well.

Thank you very much!

https://twitter.com/ohuton0125/status/1572987709391777793

Thank you very much for your help, my name is Hitoshi Itsumian, I am a Vtuber. I always enjoy watching your videos and illustrations.
I would like to make a request for you to draw an illustration of Himuka and myself, Hitoshi Itsumian.

I would like to have a scene where Himuka and I are in a smoking room, and I am borrowing Himuka's lighter.

I think there is probably a difference in physique between Himuka and me, so I would like to see Himuka lighting the lighter and me bending down to borrow it.

I would like to see Himuka-san's costume either as usual or arranged.
I would like to see her in a scajan if possible, but the earlier costumes are perfectly acceptable.
(I am sorry, but I do not have a three-sided drawing of Himuka.)

I know you are busy, but I would appreciate your consideration.

https://twitter.com/AnjiItsumi

Hello! I was drawn to your style and your self-incarnation! I'm hoping you can help illustrate my own OC/upcoming Vtuber, a lazy, overworked devil boy who works for his company's R&D department. He used to be happier and hard-working, but became disillusioned and overall exhausted at how he was treated, due to long overtime hours and unfair abuse from his bosses. As a result, the only thing he cares about is sleeping, and even wears his pajamas under his lab coat and carries an emergency pillow in case of exhaustion and napping.

His appearance is slightly feminine and androgynous, due to his long, messy hair. He also has jagged teeth and tired eyes. He usually has a tired expression, but can be excitable depending on the situation, and his hair has as "ahoge" that changes depending on his mood.

Please draw him in whatever pose or expression you see fit; I only ask that you keep in mind his jagged teeth, tired eyes and lab coat.

I'd like to use the illustration for SNS. Thank you!
